dataset_provenance: Cross-domain training. PlantVillage (controlled lab) + PlantDoc (CC BY 4.0, in-the-wild) + external images mapped onto the original 38-class PlantVillage label space. The held-out test split is unchanged. External source: Zenodo Crop Health Monitoring Dataset (CC BY 4.0, Gibson and Förster), deduplicated folders mapped onto the deployed 38-class label space; held-out test entries unchanged. See cross_domain_results.json and the matching *_dedupe_report.json for provenance.
notes: Field-robust model trained with cross-domain evaluation. In-domain lab accuracy is reported separately from in-the-wild accuracy; the app must keep presenting results as screening support, not a definitive diagnosis.
